mainEntity.name: What is an accessory suite addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory suite addition, also known as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) or in-law unit, is a secondary housing unit on a single-family residential lot. This can include converting existing space like a garage, basement, or attic, or adding a new attached or detached structure to your property. Hometelligent Inc. specializes in designing and building these units to meet various needs, such as accommodating family members, creating rental income opportunities, or adding flexible living space.
acceptedAnswer.description: An accessory suite addition, also known as an Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU), is a secondary housing unit on a single-family residential lot, often used for family, rental, or flexible living space.
